Profile
Adobe Workfront Analyst / Developer with 4+ years of 
experience configuring, administering, and optimizing 
Workfront for project and content execution, workflow 
automation, reporting, and governance. Strong expertise in 
templates, approval workflows, custom forms, Reports, 
dashboards, and system administration, with hands-on 
experience using Adobe Workfront Fusion for automation 
and API-based integrations. Skilled in requirements analysis, 
troubleshooting and error handling, data validation, reporting, 
and process improvement across cross-functional teams.
Work Experience
Workfront Analyst (Service Delivery Analyst), 
ACCENTURE SOLUTIONS PVT. LTD.
02/2022 – Present | Mumbai
•Led end-to-end configuration and administration of Adobe 
Workfront environments, including project structures, 
workflows, approval paths, layouts, job roles, schedules, and 
governance settings.
•Partnered with business stakeholders to gather and translate 
service delivery requirements into scalable Workfront 
solutions aligned with PMO and operational standards.
•Designed and implemented Adobe Workfront instances from 
scratch, including layout templates, project and request 
templates, custom forms, request queues, teams, groups, 
boards, calendars, and proofing workflows.
•Acted as the primary Workfront System Administrator, 
managing project preferences, access levels, users, roles, 
resource management rules, portfolios, programs, and intake 
processes in a high-volume FMCG environment.
•Built and maintained 150+ advanced reports and 50+ 
dashboards, providing leadership with visibility into project 
health, workload distribution, SLA adherence, and resource 
utilization.
•Extended native Workfront workflows using Adobe 
Workfront Fusion to implement event-driven automation, 
workflow orchestration, and conditional process logic 
across Workfront processes.
•Developed and supported Fusion scenarios to automate 
business processes by responding to real-time events and 
coordinating actions across tasks, approvals, and intake 
workflows, using Watch Events, filters, routers, and core 
Workfront actions (Create, Get, Search, Update, Delete).
•Performed API-based interactions within Adobe Workfront 
Fusion using REST APIs, working with endpoints, request/ 
response data, and supported operations, along with iterators, 
aggregators, and data validation logic to handle multi-
record processing, prevent duplicates, and ensure reliable 
scenario execution.
